approvalBasis: Ajay reviewed the four generated comparison candidates shown inline and said they were more than good enough for the pilot.

observations: The apple-anchor-conditioned banana and carrot are recognizable and retain their own silhouettes; no obvious apple-shape copying was observed.
Both anchor-conditioned candidates pass the deterministic alpha and framing checks.

The text-only banana and carrot are visually acceptable to Ajay as comparison controls, but both touch the canvas bounds and have an opaque corner; retain these measurements as evidence and do not promote these files to runtime sprites.

The reference condition is the better pilot canonical path for this sample because it produced clean transparency and framing for both silhouettes and a surface treatment closer to the anchor. This is preliminary evidence from two subjects, not a general guarantee.
